rule_citation: policy_checker 'commercial_use': transporting goods FOR PAYMENT (delivery) at the time of the incident
narrative: I was on my third food delivery of the evening for the delivery app, with the customer's order on the back seat, when I rear-ended a stopped car at the light on {location} while looking at the app for the next address. I get paid per delivery through the app. The other driver was fine, police attended.
